notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
A-Men 2 will be released on Steam soon. It took us a while to bring the game to you, because we are constantly working on new projects. However, we have finally managed to do so. Taking adventage of this opportunity we have also patched up the first installment of A-Men, fixing the most common bugs, and also adding some new features. Below you can find the complete change list:

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Added achievements
 [*] Added saved games integration with Steam Cloud
 [*] Added ‘portrait mode’ support
[/list]
[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Bugs reported by gamers
[/list]
